info.title: ContactOut Universal API
info.description: ContactOut provides people, company, and email intelligence APIs for profile enrichment, search, and contact verification.

get.description: Retrieves contact details for LinkedIn profiles in bulk from ContactOut.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: An array of LinkedIn profile URLs.

schema.description: An array of LinkedIn profile URLs.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

status_code.description: HTTP-style status code returned by ContactOut.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
